menu_rando_hint_items_none: Items will not be shuffled. Leaving this set to "None" will leave this profile vanilla and unrandomized
menu_rando_hint_items_easy: Items will be shuffled amongst locations of similar importance; Major items at major locations, and minor items at minor locations
menu_rando_hint_items_normal: Items will be shuffled to any viable location on the map
menu_rando_hint_items_hard: Items will be shuffled to any viable location on the map, including knowledge checks like super secret rooms and shortcuts
menu_rando_hint_progressives_off: Items of the same class will appear as normal, and able to be collected out of order
menu_rando_hint_progressives_on: Items of the same class will be rolled into a single progressive item, granting the next-highest level of gear for each item collected
menu_rando_hint_broom_off: You will start with no weaponry, needing to go find something to defend yourself with
menu_rando_hint_broom_on: You will start with a Broom, capable of dealing melee damage and opening peashooter doors
menu_rando_hint_traps_off: Trap items will not be generated
menu_rando_hint_traps_on: Any number of trap items will be placed in the world where applicable
menu_rando_hint_areas_off: You need to defeat each boss to unlock each area, as normal
menu_rando_hint_maskedItems_off: Items appear with their normal sprites
menu_rando_hint_maskedItems_on: All items are shown as the same sprite, only showing what they are when collected
menu_rando_hint_areas_on: All area-gating boss doors are unlocked from the start, allowing full access to the map
menu_rando_hint_helixLocks_off: Boss room doors will spawn like normal, just requiring the right weapon to open
menu_rando_hint_helixLocks_on: Boss room doors will be locked until a certain number of Helix Fragments has been collected, viewable by walking up to the door
menu_rando_hint_music_off: Game music will play where it normally does
menu_rando_hint_music_areas: Area themes will be shuffled amongst other areas
menu_rando_hint_music_full: Any theme can play in any location
menu_rando_hint_npcs_on: Snails can occasionally provide the location of an item when spoken to, but will otherwise say something random

subscreen_desc_snaily:
Snaily is just your average slow-going, grass-eating, fun-loving snail.  There isn't much to separate them from the rest of Snail Town, except for one thing: their drive.  Snail Town picked them for this adventure knowing Snaily wouldn't shy away and would get it done, no matter how hard it would be.

Snaily has the strength to climb up and around walls and ceilings, and sports a shell to hide in when things get scary.
subscreen_desc_sluggy:
Slugs are not an uncommon sight around these parts, but none are quite as daring and adventurous as Sluggy!  Sluggy doesn't let the threat of danger scare them away from the adventure of a lifetime, and believes Snail Town's faith is not misplaced with them.

Sluggy's lack of a shell makes them take a little more damage, but also move faster and jump higher than a snail.
subscreen_desc_upside:
Upside-Down Snail is a quirky one.  They're part gravity snail, but never quite figured out how exactly to get ahold of this power.  As such, they're locked to always falling upward.  They've gotten used to it, though, as have all their friends in town.

In spite of their strange gravity, Upside can climb walls and floors like any other snail, and their shell is just as good for hiding.
subscreen_desc_leggy:
Leggy hasn't always lived in Snail Town, but it didn't take very long at all for him to be accepted into it.  After all, he's slow and has a shell!  When he's not tracking down missing snails, Leggy likes to relax and write music.

Leggy is slower and can't climb walls, but he can flip his gravity off the bat.
subscreen_desc_blobby:
Not every blob is out to get you!!  Blobby is one such blob who has made peace with Snail Town, and has set out on this adventure to help its friends however it can.  Even if that means fighting off other blobs.

Blobby can't climb walls, instead leaning into its innate talent for jumping and the unique abilities that come with being a blob.
subscreen_desc_peashooter:
The first line of defense.  This little gun lets you fire small yet hardy peas at any wayward foe.  They're not the most effective projectile, as they crumble from contact with enemy and surface alike, but they'll do in a pinch.


Hold the SHOOT button to fire
subscreen_desc_boomerang:
These little things can pack quite the punch!  Their points and edges are refined to catch wind and foe alike.  When tossed at just the right distance, the turnaround can score some big damage!


Hold the SHOOT button to fire
subscreen_desc_rainbowWave:
It's said that those who do good in the eyes of Iris are offered a small piece of her power.  Lucky you!! These sharpened shards of solid light can cut through just about any shell, wall, or particularly stubborn slime.


Hold the SHOOT button to fire
subscreen_desc_devastator: An old relic of unknown origin, said to empower the bearer with strength and fury to rival even the highest of gods.  At least, I think so; I may have slept through that class.  Regardless, having this on you powers up all of your attacks!  Neat, huh?
subscreen_desc_highJump:
This badge is actually a container full of nothing but helium, allowing its wearer a little more air time when they jump!  Mind the fall, though; it doesn't cushion the landing very well.


Hold the JUMP button to jump as high as possible
subscreen_desc_wallGrab:
Contained inside is a ready-made meal crafted specifically to help make a blob's body stickier.  It's mostly hard candy.


Hold toward a wall or ceiling while airborne to stick to it
subscreen_desc_shellShield:
With a little polish and protective slime, your shell is now capable of withstanding damage!  From the lightest graze to the heaviest blow, nothing is too much to handle anymore! Just remember to buff out the scratches when you get home.


Press toward the ground to hide in your shell
subscreen_desc_shelmet:
Now isn't this a nice find!!  This helmet looks just about sturdy enough to shrug off a hit or two and come out unscathed.  Plus, it's fashionable!!


Press toward the ground to hide under it
subscreen_desc_rapidFire: An intriguing little gizmo.  Even just holding it makes you feel more nimble and energetic!  Throwing attacks at anything in your way should be much easier and quicker now.
subscreen_desc_normalShell:
It's you!
This is your normal self; how you've always known yourself.  You can take a hit or two, but not much else.  But hey, that just means there's room to grow!
subscreen_desc_normalShell_afterWin:
Despite everything, it's still you.
You've come far.  You've changed.  Even through it all, though, it's never a bad idea to remember who you are at your core.  Self love is important, you know!
subscreen_desc_iceShell: This frosty relic grants its bearer a close attunement with the cold, preventing harm from any icy adversaries and environmental hazards.  It also gives your body a lovely shine!
subscreen_desc_gravityShell:
This badge is crafted from discarded gravity turtle scutes that still carry some of that innate control over the force.  With a little concentration, wearing this badge allows the wearer to redirect which direction they get pulled.


Hold a direction and press the GRAVITY button to flip gravity
subscreen_desc_suffix_stackedShells: Having this ability also equips the previous shell upgrade (%s)

entity_spikeyCommon_desc:
Habitat: diverse (M.Carelia)
Demeanour: reserved
Texture: prickly

These small creatures wander the surfaces of their homes, looking for plants to eat.  They don't like to be bothered much, so they've developed spiky shells to discourage hugs.
entity_spikeyTough_desc:
Habitat: diverse
Shell: shiny
Accuracy: scarily precise

Whatever mutation causes these spikeys' shells to become orange also makes their stomachs super sensitive, causing them to not agree with the pea plants they eat.  They don't mean to attack you; you're just in the way.
entity_babyfish_desc:
Habitat: M.Carelia
Age: baby
Likes: swimming, you

Tiny passive sealife that swim through the water without a care in the world.  Babyfish are fairly social creatures, and will take an interest in any passersby.  They usually migrate elsewhere as they grow.
entity_floatspike_desc:
Habitat: diverse
Head: empty
Life: easy

These simple urchins tend to gravitate toward areas either full of water or otherwise verdant and damp.  They like to find a spot and sit idly for a long time.  The way they tend to gather has led to theories of unknown floatspike societies, but with little evidence.
entity_blobCommon_desc:
Habitat: diverse
Texture: slimy, pliable
Taste: would not recommend

The blob is a humble creature.  Being made purely of slime, its malleable surface can be bent and reshaped to its whim.  Their appearance around where snails tend to reside makes one wonder if they rose from residual snail trails.
entity_blobTough_desc:
Habitat: diverse
Senses: heightened
Diet: unknown

Blobs have an impressive ability to adapt to their environments as they age.  Generally, this tends to involve a strengthening of surface tension and a change in pigmentation.  Blub also loves listening to music.
entity_chirpy_desc:
Habitat: M.Carelia
Plumage: well-groomed
Energy: endless

Chirpies never stay in the same place for long, always flying from one area to another and never quite settling in.  Some say they're adventurous by nature, always looking for new and interesting places to fly...
entity_battybat_desc:
Habitat: diverse
Demeanour: skittish
Energy: low

Batty Bat doesn't want to cause harm.  It's just that when you sneak up on them while they're sleeping, and they startle as easily as they do, panic sets in fast.  Batty Bat's favorite cereal flavor is chocolate.
entity_fireball_desc:
Habitat: diverse (A.Abyssus)
Feeling: fired up
Temperature: toasty

A wandering nature spirit attuned to the element of heat.  Despite being a living ball of flame, they don't produce any smoke, and hardly ever ignite things around them.  They'd make perfect snuggle buddies, if only they weren't so darn hot!
entity_iceball_desc:
Habitat: diverse (S.Silere)
Life: chill
Texture: misty

A wandering nature spirit attuned to the element of cold.  A cloud of icy air surrounds them closely, making it difficult to see where they're going, but they don't seem to mind.  Believe it or not, not a fan of ice puns; they've heard 'em all before.
entity_ghostball_desc:
Habitat: diverse (S.Silere)
Feeling: unbothered, happy
Weight: lighter than air

Some spirits are naturally lazier than others, and choose to embody calmer elements.  This one has become one with the wind, letting the breeze carry it wherever it desires.  It's hard to tell, but ghost dandelion might be asleep.
entity_snelk_desc:
Habitat: unknown
Vibe: mysterious
Fur: soft, snuggly

Secret Snelks are a wondrous enigma.  They tend to hide away in and around spots most people don't know about, which makes even seeing one a rarity.  Some say they'd make great companions, if only you could get them to stop jumping.
entity_kitty_desc:
Habitat: S.Silere
Age: 8 years old
Personal space: huge

Kitty is territorial by nature, laying claim to all that it sees.  Strange, then, that all it seems to do in its zone when unbothered is sleep.  Some kitties like to gather in small groups and share the space.
entity_canon_desc:
Habitat: Diverse (L.Lirata)
Finish: shiny
Hinges: freshly oiled

This heavy-duty machine is driven by a rudimentary machine-learning algorithm that receives positive feedback whenever it hits its mark. Unfortunately, the machine isn't quite precise enough to keep up with the algorithm's enthusiasm.
entity_snakey_desc:
Habitat: Diverse (A.Abyssus)
Skin: fresh
Flexibility: incredible

A born explorer, Snakey likes to wind its way into places it really shouldn't be.  It collects little trinkets and oddities to hoard or resell later.  It loves to break out in dance when it hears music, too--an activity it finds slightly embarrassing.
entity_turtleCommon_desc:
Habitat: A.Abyssus
Shell: tough
Top speed: 32 px/sec

Turtles, oddly, are born with an innate control over their own gravity.  They claim it's a boon from the turtle god, who walks laps around the sky to keep it moving.  Fitting, then, that they often use this power as their own mode of transport.
entity_turtleTough_desc:
Habitat: A.Abyssus
Finish: shiny
Top speed: 33 px/sec

It's not uncommon for turtles to choose a rather colorful method of self-expression, the most common method being eye-catching full-body coloration.  The upkeep is time-consuming, of course, but you have to admit the results are immaculate!
entity_jellyfish_desc:
Habitat: A.Abyssus
Thoughts: none
Texture: slimy, squishy

In spite of the difference in home terrain, Jellyfish tout a few similarities to Blobs.  Their bodies are similar in composition, and their brain capacity is fairly equal, though devoted to different things (notably: swimming, and... more swimming).
entity_seahorse_desc:
Habitat: A.Abyssus
Form: graceful
And: knows it

Syngnathida faces a conflict in life.  It's a beauty to watch as it glides through the water, and it loves the attention, but it's also instinctively territorial.  Trying to find a careful balance has proven to be a difficult but worthwhile life goal.
entity_walleye_desc:
Habitat: Diverse
Eyesight: really good
Reaction time: incredible

What is a walleye?  Is it a volatile crystalline mass?  A creature in the shape of an eye as a sort of camouflage?  An actual eye embedded in the wall?  Nobody can get close enough long enough to investigate.
entity_shellbreaker_desc:
Habitat: M.Carelia
Feeling: a little grumpy
Ammo supply: infinite

As a blob ages, funny things happen to its body.  Shellbreaker's once-fragile surface has hardened into a tough carapace, and they've gained a high level of control over their projectiles.  Their favorite music genre is drum & bass.
entity_stompy_desc:
Habitat: S.Silere
Smell: not great
Body: unknown

A menace to snails and biologists alike, this odd creature (pair of creatures?) guards its turf with an iron toe, making a ton of noise in the process.  It's a wonder the floors haven't cracked!
